# Official RepNet checkpoint evaluation adapter

This directory preserves the reviewed adapter for Google's updated RepNet checkpoint release, not a self-trained replacement or a claim to reproduce the original 2020 paper number. The architecture, checkpoint-variable mapping and inference functions are extracted from the [official notebook at commit60d48fc](https://github.com/google-research/google-research/blob/60d48fc1b71b6126462136cad441dd76da7460d0/repnet/repnet_colab.ipynb). The upstream Apache2 license and source notice are retained. Only notebook UI, acquisition and demonstration calls were omitted from the extracted core.

`evaluation_config.json` fixes the source/weight hashes, all357 evaluation records, inference settings, original UCF inclusive annotation segments, and GPU1 predecessor condition. `RUN_CONTRACT.md` and `SPEC.md` describe the server-only execution. The original released continuous outputs and harmonized annotated-count metrics are saved separately. Evaluation includes the zero-count and disputed RepCount records; no failed row may silently disappear.

Current deployment is `/root/autodl-tmp/TempoRAC/external-baselines-20261112/repnet-runner`. The explicit user resumption and `GATE_AMENDMENT.md` replace the old training-success dependency with truthful stop receipts, absent old workers and an unowned GPU1. The active entry point is `run_official_repnet.py`: one witness followed by one full evaluation. It is not a recurring scheduler. The scientific core, input/scoring contract and official checkpoint remain unchanged. The earlier `finite_repnet_worker.py`, `SPEC.md`, `BUILD_NOTE.md`, and `FINAL_DRAFT_RECEIPT.json` are historical November11 artifacts, not the current launch instruction or current config identity.

The inherited adapter closure is in `docs/evidence/resume_20261111/repnet_official_closure_20261111.md`; the current scheduling-only closure is `docs/evidence/resume_20261112/repnet_gate_closure_20261112.md`. They are same-family provisional and do not themselves prove package installation, checkpoint restoration, complete evaluation or scientific quality. Current runtime receipts determine those states. Large checkpoint files, decoded videos and private connection material are not distributed in this repository.
